info.name: V-MAS API Collection
info.description:
This is a clean and organized API collection for the V-MAS (Vehicle Management System) project.

### Authentication flow
1. Use any of the **Login as...** requests under the **Authentication** folder.
2. Successful login will automatically update the `authToken` collection variable via a post-response test script.
3. All other requests automatically inherit this bearer token.
